name: search_pubmed_articles
description: Search PubMed for biomedical articles based on a free-text query with optional filters for publication year range, journal name, and author last name. Use this tool when the user requests to find scientific papers or literature on a biomedical topic. Do NOT use for non-biomedical literature (e.g. CS papers — use arXiv tools instead).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text search query using PubMed query syntax. Supports Boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT) and MeSH terms. Example: 'cancer AND therapy'. Should be a complete query string, not just keywords.

parameters.name: min_year
parameters.description: Earliest publication year to include (inclusive), as a 4-digit year (e.g. 2020). Articles published before this year are excluded. Omit to include all years.

parameters.name: max_year
parameters.description: Latest publication year to include (inclusive), as a 4-digit year (e.g. 2023). Articles published after this year are excluded. Omit to include all years.

parameters.name: journal_name
parameters.description: Name of the journal to filter results by. Should match the journal title as indexed in PubMed. Omit to include articles from all journals.

parameters.name: author_last_name
parameters.description: Last name of the author to filter results by. Should match the author's last name as indexed in PubMed. Omit to include articles by all authors.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of articles to return, ranked by PubMed relevance score. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 20 if not specified.

articles.description: List of matching articles, ranked by relevance. Each item has: pmid (string), title (string), authors (array of strings), journal (string), year (integer), abstract (string).

total_count.description: Total number of matches in PubMed, which may exceed max_results.

return_schema.description: Object with 'articles' (list of metadata) and 'total_count' (total matches before truncation).
